name: nmap
title: Nmap
description: Network reconnaissance with Nmap: TCP connect port scans, service and version detection, NSE scripts and a quick top-100 scan, with parsed results. Needs network: Full (scans go to arbitrary hosts and ports, which an HTTP allowlist cannot carry).
license: MIT (MCP server, FuzzingLabs) AND Nmap licence (GPL-2.0 with clarifications, Debian package)
notes: TCP connect scans only: axross grants the container no NET_RAW, so SYN, UDP and OS-detection scans are not offered. Scan only systems you are authorized to test.
